runbooks.name: Degraded Microservice Auto-Restart & Traffic Drain
execution_steps: Mark instance unhealthy in Consul/Envoy service mesh
Restart container and execute health check probe

runbooks.name: PostgreSQL Connection Pool Exhaustion Self-Healing
execution_steps: Scale PgBouncer replica connection ceiling dynamically
Shed non-critical background analytics read load to read-replica
Verify active pool utilization drops below 70%

runbooks.name: Celery / Redis Queue Congestion & Poison Pill Quarantine
runbooks.trigger_condition: Queue backlog > 10,000 tasks and worker lag > 120s
execution_steps: Isolate repeated unparseable payload tasks to Dead-Letter Queue
Drain backlogged asynchronous batch OCR tasks

runbooks.name: AI Model Provider Outage Autonomous Fallback
runbooks.trigger_condition: Primary LLM API timeout rate > 10% or HTTP 429/503 spikes
execution_steps: Trip circuit breaker on primary AI model provider
Route live prompt workload to secondary backup model provider
Adjust prompt formatting/context window parameters for secondary model
Run automated response quality verification on sample inferences
Resume primary provider routing once health probe passes 5 consecutive times
